hardware: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14650HX, 24 threads, 16 GB RAM, CPU only, Windows 11, Python 3.12.13
command: .venv-heavy/Scripts/python -m passageport.evaluation.run evaluate --datasets mini --embedding sentence-transformers:Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-base --reranker sentence-transformers:Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-reranker-base --label 'Upstream models, improved pipeline' --out ../eval/results/upstream-models.json
tokenizer: unicode case-fold, identifier-aware (compound + parts), stopwords, stemming: plural
label: Upstream models, improved pipeline

datasets.name: mini
datasets.description: Hand-written technical corpus (operating systems, networking, databases, an API spec in two versions, operations, security, a research-style report). A hit is relevant when its chunk overlaps the labelled quote. Small and self-authored: indicative only.
